title: IJCNN 2023 Publication: Relation-Aware Subgraph Retrieval for KBQA
summary: This community centers on the paper 'Improving Complex Knowledge Base Question Answering with Relation-Aware Subgraph Retrieval and Reasoning Network,' published at the International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN) 2023. The work was authored by a collaborative team of five researchers: Dan Luo, Jiawei Sheng, Hongbo Xu, Lihong Wang, and Bin Wang. The paper focuses on enhancing complex question answering systems through specific retrieval and reasoning mechanisms.
key_findings: The paper was presented at IJCNN 2023, held in Gold Coast, Australia, from June 18-23, 2023.
The authorship consists of five individuals: Dan Luo, Jiawei Sheng, Hongbo Xu, Lihong Wang, and Bin Wang.
The publication spans pages 1–8 of the conference proceedings.
The research specifically addresses 'Complex Knowledge Base Question Answering' using a 'Relation-Aware Subgraph Retrieval and Reasoning Network.'
The paper is cited in the context of other recent works in knowledge base question answering, such as 'ChatKBQA' and 'Reasoning on Graphs.'
The work is distinct from other cited papers like 'Zero-Shot Entity Linking by Reading Entity Descriptions' (ACL 2019), indicating a focus on graph-based reasoning rather than entity linking alone.
